name: @chaoticgoodcomputing/obsidian-annotator
//: The Annotator, a hard fork of elias-sundqvist/obsidian-annotator (NOTICE.md): the Obsidian plugin, built with esbuild into dist/.

build.//: dist/: main.js and manifest.json, as Obsidian loads a plugin (scripts/build.mjs).

dev.//: Rebuilds dist/ on every change, unminified, with inline source maps.

install-in-vault.//: Run by hand, never by a build: copies dist/ into content/.obsidian/plugins/obsidian-annotator, which git ignores, keeping the plugin's settings (data.json). `--vault=<path>` installs into another vault (scripts/install-in-vault.mjs).
